summary: Added inline Sonnet judgeEdge filter (second-pass relevance gate) to arms.run_retrieve_and_answer in bench/zonoid_bench/arms.py. New public API: _dag_judge_edge (single-edge binary keep/prune via claude-sonnet-4-6), filter_dag_edges_with_judge (batch filter, returns kept/pruned lists), and WiringResult.dag_judge_pruned (provenance). Gate: off by default, enabled via BENCH_DAG_JUDGE=1 env var or dag_judge=True kwarg on run_retrieve_and_answer. Model default claude-sonnet-4-6, overridable via ZONOID_BENCH_DAG_JUDGE_MODEL. Fail-open on LLM failure (prune only when model returns explicit keep=false). 20 unit tests in bench/zonoid_bench/test_dag_judge_filter.py — all pass, including core assertion that the filter prunes ≥1 irrelevant edge on a 3-edge mixed fixture. Commit: 23ebbea on orch/attempt/bench-dag-judge-patch.
